Fix Notes / Testing

Is version me connect button ko inline onclick fallback + DOM event dono diye gaye hain. Ethers CDN fallback added hai. History chunking added hai. File protocol warning added hai.

  1. Best test: python -m http.server 8000 and open http://localhost:8000/athar_final_fixed_dapp.html
  2. Browser: MetaMask extension with BSC Mainnet.
  3. Mobile normal Chrome me WalletConnect nahi hai; Trust Wallet dApp browser/MetaMask browser use karein.
  4. Full history ke liye deployment block set karein, warna default last 50,000 blocks.
